items.title: North Korean Cyber Threat Coordination
points: Coinbase co-sponsored a two-day Dublin symposium with the US State Department, joining Global Affairs Canada, Google, and Payward.

FBI, FinCEN, and Ireland's Garda National Cyber Crime Bureau participated, covering crypto heists funding North Korean weapons programs and fake IT workers using false identities to secure remote jobs at crypto firms.
The event consolidated US, Canadian, and Irish law enforcement with major crypto and tech companies into a shared operational framework against state-sponsored financial crime.

items.title: Regulatory Push Against SEC Crypto Exemptions
points: Senators Elizabeth Warren, Chris Van Hollen, and Tina Smith demanded the SEC withdraw its August crypto offering rules and tokenized stock 'innovation exemption.'
The exemption allows crypto offerings up to $5M for four years and up to $75M for one year without typical SEC registration oversight.

Critics argue the five-year innovation exemption, which would stop tokenized securities venues from being classified as exchanges, creates a 'shadow stock market' fragmenting liquidity and inviting illicit finance.

items.title: Tokenized Equity Market Expansion
points: OKX launched OKXICE, routing six equity tokens through Uniswap v4 pools (liquidity pools enabling trading without a central order book) for 24/7 on-chain trading, with $1.22M in day-one liquidity.

OKX plans a rollout of 113 total assets, extending tokenized equities into natively on-chain instruments composable with existing DeFi protocols (blockchain applications that can interact with each other).

Backpack Exchange deployed an open RFQ system (request for quote: multiple market makers submit competing bids to fill an order), letting any market maker compete with Backpack's broker to offer the best price on retail orders.

items.title: Developer Infrastructure and Stablecoin Job Market
points: A developer-compiled directory cataloged 75+ free-tier crypto APIs across 10 categories, led by dRPC (50M compute units/month), Helius (1M credits/month), and Alchemy (30M compute units/month).
A dozen API providers, including Jupiter, DEX Screener, Hyperliquid, Binance, PublicNode, Pyth, ENS, and mempool.space, require no API key at all.
A review of 27 stablecoin companies found 227 non-technical career roles (business, compliance, operations) as of November 24, signaling job market maturity beyond engineering.

items.title: Nvidia Settlement and LayerZero Validator Additions
points: Nvidia settled for $290M over allegations it understated crypto mining's contribution to 2017-2018 gaming GPU sales.
LayerZero added Samsung Card, Kakao Pay, and ZAN as genesis validators ahead of its November 30 Layer 1 blockchain launch.
